user_input: According to AA25-071A, which ATT&CK technique is connected to Medusa actors through the reported use of PsExec? Explain the two-hop actor-to-software-to-technique path with evidence.
response:
Medusa actors use PsExec to connect to a remote system. [E1, E2, E3]
The ATT&CK technique connected to Medusa actors through PsExec is T1052. [E1, E2, E3]
